_about: Variables of a waterbody, computed in seft/wb/indicators.py from its yearly water series, its zone of influence, the villages of its home micro-watershed and the MWS drought years; and the fields used to assign its type (seft/wb/build.py). Signals, roles and rules also read the home MWS's variables as mws_<id> (see the watershed variables.json), its system shares as share_<system> and its context classes as ctx_<dimension>. Series are per hydrological year 2017–2024 (July to June).

variables.label: Area
variables.description: Area of the waterbody's mapped extent (area_ored: every pixel that held water in any season of any year), after merging fragments of one waterbody.

variables.label: Catchment ÷ waterbody area
variables.description: Catchment area draining to the waterbody divided by its area. A large ratio means much runoff for its size; a small one, that the catchment may not fill it.

variables.label: Years with water
variables.description: Number of hydrological years 2017–2024 in which any part of the extent held water in kharif.

variables.label: First year with water
variables.description: First hydrological year in which it held water in kharif.

variables.label: New since 2022
variables.description: First wet in 2022 or later and wet in every year since: mostly farm ponds dug recently.

variables.label: Holds water regularly
variables.description: Wet in 3 or more of the 8 years and not new. Most rules are checked only for these.

variables.label: Kharif fill (mean)
variables.description: Mean share of the extent holding water in kharif, over the years with data (k).

variables.label: Rabi water (mean)
variables.description: Mean share of the extent holding water through kharif and rabi (kr).

variables.label: Summer water (mean)
variables.description: Mean share of the extent holding water through kharif, rabi and zaid (krz).

variables.label: Kharif fill in normal years
variables.description: Mean kharif fill in years that were not drought years in the home MWS; the mean of all years if there was no drought year.

variables.label: Water kept into rabi
variables.description: Mean rabi water divided by mean kharif fill: 1 means all the water seen in kharif is still there in rabi.

variables.label: Water kept into summer
variables.description: Mean summer water divided by mean kharif fill.

variables.label: Kharif fill, first three years
variables.description: Mean kharif fill in 2017–2019.

variables.label: Kharif fill, last two years
variables.description: Mean kharif fill in 2023–2024.

variables.label: Highest kharif fill, last two years
variables.description: The higher of the 2023 and 2024 kharif fill.

variables.label: Kharif fill trend
variables.description: Theil–Sen slope of kharif fill, in percentage points a year.

variables.label: Fill relative to the tehsil
variables.description: Mean of relative fill: each year's kharif fill divided by the median fill that year of the tehsil's waterbodies that hold water in 3 or more years. 1 means as full as a typical neighbour.

variables.label: Relative fill, first three years
variables.description: Mean relative fill in 2017–2019.

variables.label: Relative fill, last two years
variables.description: Mean relative fill in 2023–2024.

variables.label: Recent ÷ early relative fill
variables.description: Relative fill in the last two years divided by that of the first three years. Low values mean it has stopped filling compared with its neighbours.

variables.label: Fill trend relative to the tehsil
variables.description: Theil–Sen slope of relative fill. Dividing by the tehsil median removes the year's rainfall, so a drought year does not read as decline.

variables.label: Summer water trend
variables.description: Theil–Sen slope of summer water (krz), in percentage points a year.

variables.label: Recent ÷ early kharif fill
variables.description: Kharif fill in the last two years divided by that of the first three years (not adjusted for rainfall).

variables.label: Kharif fill, normal years
variables.description: Mean kharif fill in years that were not drought years in the home MWS.

variables.label: Kharif fill, drought years
variables.description: Mean kharif fill in the home MWS's drought years: 4 or more weeks of moderate or severe drought in kharif (CoRE Stack kharif drought data).

variables.label: Drought years
variables.description: Number of years with 4 or more moderate or severe drought weeks in kharif in the home MWS.

variables.label: Normal years
variables.description: Number of years that were not drought years and have drought data.

variables.label: Fill in drought ÷ normal years
variables.description: Kharif fill in drought years divided by fill in normal years; needs at least 1 drought and 2 normal years.

variables.label: Zone of influence known
variables.description: A zone of influence was joined to the waterbody, by its id or by location (centre within 10 m or 10% of its size, radius within 25% of the expected radius).

variables.label: Cropping intensity in zone of influence
variables.description: Mean cropping intensity (cropped area over cultivable area) in the zone of influence, 2017–2024.

variables.label: Cropping intensity trend in zone of influence
variables.description: Theil–Sen slope of cropping intensity in the zone of influence.

variables.label: Double and triple cropped share of zone of influence
variables.description: Mean double- plus triple-cropped area divided by the cultivable area of the zone of influence.

variables.label: Villages with fishery
variables.description: Share of the home MWS's village area whose villages report community fish ponds or fish farming in Mission Antyodaya.

variables.label: Villages irrigating from surface water
variables.description: Share of the home MWS's village area whose villages name tanks, ponds, rivers or canals as the main irrigation source in Mission Antyodaya.

type_fields.label: Layer type
type_fields.description: CoRE Stack's own class for the waterbody: 'individual', 'river' or 'canal' (blank in old layers).

type_fields.label: On a drainage line
type_fields.description: Any fragment of the waterbody lies on a mapped drainage line.

type_fields.label: Stream order
type_fields.description: Highest Strahler order of the drainage lines it lies on (1 = smallest headwater channels).

type_fields.label: Micro-watersheds spanned
type_fields.description: Number of micro-watersheds the waterbody overlaps.

type_fields.label: Layer has drainage fields
type_fields.description: False for old layers without drainage, stream order and type fields (issue WB-10).

type_fields.label: Main inflow (from answers)
type_fields.description: Set only by a community answer: 'stream', 'runoff' or 'canal'. Unknown from data.

type_fields.label: Ownership (from answers)
type_fields.description: Set only by a community answer: 'private' (one farmer or family) or 'common' (village, panchayat or government). Unknown from data.
